title: carpinus ulmoides
intro: Carpinus ulmoides, commonly known as Chinese Horse Chestnut or Li Zhi He, is a plant native to Asia, belonging to the Betulaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, improve blood circulation, and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Carpinus ulmoides include its vasodilatory and anti-inflammatory effects, which contribute to its use in treating conditions such as varicose veins and hemorrhoids. The bioactive constituents of Carpinus ulmoides include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
